key_difference: (D) misses (B)'s Windows precheck for literal backslashes, which QUrl stores in decoded form, so on Windows a path containing an unencoded '\' is still accepted (and silently passes the no-'%' fast path); (D) also adds its own UTF-8 decoder via a new traits struct, where (B) relies on valid UTF-8 already being folded to UTF-16 and rejects any decoded byte >= 0x80.
